# Introduction

This example script shows how the scaling of the simulated example data `dat3` with the NEPSroutines package could look like. See the example script `dat3_data_preparation.Rmd` for an illustration of the corresponding data preparation.

Read `help("dat3", package = "NEPSroutines")` for information on the data and included variables.

# Preparation of R and data

## Install NEPSroutines

Install the latest official release using the instructions in the
[README](https://github.com/LIfBi-Educational-Measurement/NEPSroutines#installation).
Run the installation commands once in the R console;
they are not run automatically when knitting this document. 

```r
# Install pak first if it is not already installed.
install.packages("pak")

# Install a fixed release, rather than the development version.
pak::pak("LIfBi-Educational-Measurement/NEPSroutines@vX.Y.Z")
```

Replace `vX.Y.Z` with the correct tag for the latest release from the
[Releases page](https://github.com/LIfBi-Educational-Measurement/NEPSroutines/releases).
Keep the chosen tag in your script to record which release you used.
Restart R after updating a package that was already loaded.

## Load package and example data

```{r load, message = FALSE}

library("NEPSroutines")

data("dat3")
resp <- dat3$resp
vars <- dat3$vars

```

## User-defined missing values

Set user-defined missing values (see vignette `prepare_data`) if not yet done so in the data preparation.

```{r user-defined missing values}

table(unlist(resp[vars$item]))

mvs = c(
  OM = -97,
  NV = -95,
  NR = -94,
  NP = -56,
  ND = -55,
  MD = -54
)

labels_mvs = c(
  ALL = "total missing items",
  OM = "omitted items",
  NV = "not valid items",
  NR = "not reached items",
  NP = "not participated",
  ND = "not determinable items",
  MD = "items missing by design"
)

```

## Labels for socio-demographic variables

Set labels for socio-demographic variables (see vignette `prepare_data`) if not yet done so in the data preparation.

```{r attributes}

# Sex
attributes(resp$sex)$labels <- c(
  female = 0,
  male = 1
)

# Migration
attributes(resp$mig)$labels <- c(
  no_migration_background = 0,
  migration_background = 1
)

# Books
attributes(resp$books)$labels <- c(
  less_than_100 = 0,
  more_than_100 = 1
)

```

## Create variables indicating common items 

Because the simulated test data consists of three booklets, common items between all booklets are defined for further analyses. The variable `common` defines all common items, whereas `dich` and `mixed` define only the common dichotomously scored items or the common mixed/final item set.

```{r common items}

vars$common <- vars$easy & vars$medium & vars$difficult
resp$common <- TRUE

vars$dich_common <- vars$dich & vars$common
vars$mixed_common <- vars$mixed & vars$common

```

# Sample and Booklet Descriptives

See vignette `descriptive_analyses`.

```{r descriptives}

# Sample size with only valid cases
NEPSroutines::n_valid(resp, valid = "valid")

# Descriptives (mean, sd, etc.) of continuous variables
NEPSroutines::desc_con(resp, desc = "age", valid = "valid")

# Descriptives (attributes, frequency) of nominal socio-demographic variables
NEPSroutines::show_attributes(resp, desc = c("sex", "mig", "books"))
NEPSroutines::desc_nom(resp, desc = c("sex", "mig", "books"), valid = "valid")

# Descriptives (attributes, frequency) of nominal booklet variables
NEPSroutines::desc_nom(resp, desc = "booklet", valid = "valid")

# Sample size by test version
NEPSroutines::sample_by_group(
  resp = resp,
  grouping_variable = "booklet",
  save = TRUE,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  path = "tables"
)

# Item type by test version
NEPSroutines::props_by_group(
  vars = vars,
  select = "mixed",
  grouping = c("easy",  "medium", "difficult"),
  properties = c("texttype"),
  save = TRUE,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  path = "tables"
)

```


# Missing Responses Analyses

See vignette `missing_values_analyses`.

## Missing Responses by Person

```{r missing responses by person}

NEPSroutines::mv_person(
  resp = resp,
  vars = vars,
  select = "mixed",
  valid = "valid",
  mvs = mvs,
  labels_mvs = labels_mvs,
  missing_by_design = c(-54,-56),
  overwrite = TRUE,
  plots = TRUE,
  save = TRUE,
  print = TRUE,
  return = FALSE,
  path_results = "results",
  path_table = "tables",
  path_plots = "plots/missings_by_person",
  digits = 2,
  warn = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE
)

```

## Missing Responses by Item

```{r missing responses by item}

NEPSroutines::mv_item(
  resp = resp,
  vars = vars,
  select = "mixed",
  valid = "valid",
  mvs = mvs,
  labels_mvs = labels_mvs,
  missing_by_design = c(-54,-56),
  grouping = c("easy", "medium", "difficult"),
  position = c(
    easy = "pos_easy",
    medium = "pos_medium",
    difficult = "pos_difficult"
  ),
  show_all = FALSE,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  plots = TRUE,
  save = TRUE,
  print = TRUE,
  return = FALSE,
  path_results = "results",
  path_table = "tables",
  path_plots = "plots/missings_by_item",
  digits = 2,
  warn = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE
)

```


# IRT Analyses

See vignette `irt_analyses`.

## Dichotomous items

IRT analyses for all dichotomously scored items (e.g., single-choice items and subtasks of polytomous items). Estimates Rasch and 2PL models.

```{r IRT analysis with dichotomous items}

NEPSroutines::irt_analysis(
  resp = resp,
  vars = vars,
  select = "dich",
  valid = "valid",
  mvs = mvs,
  plots = TRUE,
  save = TRUE,
  print = TRUE,
  return = FALSE,
  path_results = "results",
  path_table = "tables",
  path_plots = "plots",
  overwrite = TRUE,
  digits = 2,
  verbose = FALSE
)

```

## All items

IRT analyses for all scored items included in the final item set (no subtasks). Estimates PCM and GPCM.

```{r IRT analysis with all items}

NEPSroutines::irt_analysis(
  resp = resp,
  vars = vars,
  select = "mixed",
  valid = "valid",
  scoring = "scoring",
  mvs = mvs,
  plots = TRUE,
  save = TRUE,
  print = TRUE,
  return = FALSE,
  path_results = "results",
  path_table = "tables",
  path_plots = "plots",
  overwrite = TRUE,
  digits = 2,
  verbose = FALSE
)

```


# DIF Analysis

See vignette `dif_analyses`.

## Dichotomous items

DIF analyses for all dichotomously scored items (e.g., single-choice items and subtasks of polytomous items). Usually not required.

```{r dif analysis for dichotomous items}

NEPSroutines::dif_analysis(
  resp = resp,
  vars = vars,
  valid = "valid",
  dif_vars = c("booklet", "sex", "mig", "books"),
  select = c("dich_common", "dich", "dich", "dich"),
  scoring = "scoring",
  mvs = mvs,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE,
  save = TRUE,
  print = TRUE,
  return = FALSE,
  path_results = "results",
  path_table = "tables"
)

```

## All items

DIF analyses for all scored items included in the final item set (no subtasks). 

```{r dif analysis for all items}

NEPSroutines::dif_analysis(
  resp = resp,
  vars = vars,
  valid = "valid",
  dif_vars = c("booklet", "sex", "mig", "books"),
  select = c("mixed_common", "mixed", "mixed", "mixed"),
  scoring = "scoring",
  mvs = mvs,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE,
  save = TRUE,
  print = TRUE,
  return = FALSE,
  path_results = "results",
  path_table = "tables"
)

```


# Distractor Analysis

See vignette `distractor_analyses`.

```{r distractor analysis}

NEPSroutines::dis_analysis(
  resp = resp,
  vars = vars,
  valid = "valid",
  select_raw = "raw",
  correct = "correct",
  mvs = mvs,
  print = TRUE,
  save = TRUE,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  path_results = "results",
  path_table = "tables"
)

```


# Dimensionality Analysis

See vignette `dimensionality_analyses`.
If dimensionality variable is a factor, it needs to be converted to numeric.

```{r dimensionality analysis}

# Create numerical dimensionality variable
vars$texttype_num <- as.numeric(as.factor(vars$texttype))
table(vars$texttype, vars$texttype_num)

# Conduct dimensionality analysis
NEPSroutines::dim_analysis(
  resp = resp,
  vars = vars,
  select = "mixed",
  valid = "valid",
  scoring = "scoring",
  irtmodel = "PCM2",
  dim = "texttype_num",
  mvs = mvs,
  return = FALSE,
  save = TRUE,
  print = TRUE,
  path_table = "tables", 
  path_results = "results",
  overwrite = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE
)

```


# Create Scores and SUF

See vignettes `create_scores` and `create_suf`.

```{r suf}

scores <- NEPSroutines::create_scores(
  resp,
  vars,
  score_name = "reg7",
  select = "mixed",
  valid = "valid",
  scoring = "scoring",
  mvs = mvs,
  wle = TRUE,
  sum_score = TRUE,
  sum_select = "dich",
  metap = FALSE,
  return = TRUE,
  save = TRUE,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  path_results = "results"
)

NEPSroutines::create_suf(
  resp,
  vars,
  select = "mixed",
  competence = "Reading",
  scores = scores,
  score_name = "reg7",
  return = FALSE,
  path = "suf"
)

rm(scores)

```


# Session

Print session information (e.g., loaded packages). Important for reproducible results!

```{r session-info}
sessionInfo()
```
